title: ShiftwiseConv: Small Convolutional Kernel with Large Kernel Effect
mechanism: Gets a large-kernel effect from multi-path shifted small kernels with sparse long-range dependencies; pure CNN that beats SLaK and UniRepLKNet.
adaptation: Use the ImageNet-pretrained SW backbone as the U-Net++ encoder with a 1-channel stem and PF fine-tune. Long sparse context may separate scuff streaks from cracks on E1 half-cut cells.
min_experiment: Arm: SW encoder U-Net++ PF, 3 then 5 seeds. Baseline: PF ResNet-34. Metrics: E1 crack relF1@2, test crack IoU, inactive IoU. Kill: both E1 relF1@2 and test crack IoU within noise after 3 seeds.
evidence: R: beats SLaK and UniRepLKNet in classification, segmentation and detection (ADE20K etc.; numbers not read).
prior_overlap: none. Only ResNet-34/50 encoders were tested.
